Simple C25K - Fitness trainer (Mini review in comments)

So I decided to try the C25K (couch to 5k) and wanted an app from the F-droid market. This is literally the only one I could find.

Quickly on what C25K is. Basically it starts you from never running to being able to run 5k (~3 miles) in about 9 weeks through a routine of walking and jogging/running.

How the app works is when you start it, you pick which week/day you are on (Example week 3 day 2) and then start. You start with a walk and when you hear a tone you are to run. While running you hear the same tone to let you know it's time to walk. These will go back and forth until you are done with the routine. Once the routine is done you hear two tones to let you know you have completed the work for that day.

It rather basic as it doesn't keep what you have done, and what you have next. However I prefer this since you might find you have to repeat a week or day. It's last update was 2012-10-05, but since what it does is rather basic it really doesn't need much past what it has. Has not crashed on me. Will work in conjunction with audio player (currently listening to music via vanilla player also from F-droid).

Does what it says on the tin. 10/10.

:E: just noticed they have a check mark on completed days. So it does keep record.
